items: New: Device Migration — move your apps from an old phone to a new one over Wi-Fi
Send just the app list, or the APK/XAPK files as well, then install everything back with one tap
The new phone flags versions you already have, signature conflicts and apps it can't run
Apps installed from the store get a one-tap link to their store page
Free plan moves up to 5 apps; the home screen card can be hidden in Settings
Auto Backup is now free, with the slots in use shown in Version History
The XAPK Installer shows each step and its result, with a Hide button
The Apks list and detail page show the real app name and icon, and open instantly
Full-screen on tablets and foldables; rotation no longer interrupts an export
Fixed the folder path shown for exports saved via the system file picker
Redesigned every dialog in Settings — rounded cards, clearer options and consistent brand colours
Fixed radio buttons, text cursors and dividers showing the wrong colour in night mode
The language picker now lays out correctly in right-to-left languages such as Arabic
Smaller download size thanks to code and resource shrinking
